verdict.rationale: n8n's docs describe error workflows that let you control how n8n responds when a workflow execution fails [n8n-docs-5]. Community users corroborate that failed runs are kept in execution history for debugging [n8n-comm-8], and that retries are used to absorb errors [n8n-comm-18]. Notification is only implied, by pairing the error workflow with messaging integrations such as Slack [n8n-intdir-2]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of failure notifications, evidence of in-workflow per-node error branches, and in-depth docs beyond a single summary line.
